Definition: an Amramite or descendant of Amram
BiblicalUsage: The Amramites were the descendants of Amram, one of the families of the Kohathites, counted with the Izharites, Hebronites and Uzzielites in the census of the Levites. In David's day the Amramites appear again among the treasurers of the house of God, keeping the dedicated things with the other Kohathite families.
TheologicalSignificance: A family name on a census list still tells me something: the children of Amram kept serving in the house of God generations after their father, and God counts the families who keep showing up.
